title: Forward scan-fold configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite word over an alphabet $\Gamma$, let $A$ be a state space, let $k$ be the number of work tapes, let $\delta:A\to\Gamma\to A$, let $a_0\in A$, and let $d$ be a configuration on input $x$. For $r\in\mathbb{N}$, retain the other fields of $d$, set the state to the forward phase carrying the fold of $\delta$ from $a_0$ over the first $\min(r,|x|)$ symbols of $x$, and place the input head at position $\min(r,|x|)+1$ (with the input positions shifted by one).
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
